verdict.rationale: A GPU is hardware, but the evidence shows it ships an AI assistant, Project G-Assist, that "helps you tune, control, and optimize your system," which implies AI-driven suggestions based on system data, so the axis applies. Beyond that, AI insights on a user's own data require third-party models or runtimes (Ollama, ComfyUI, PyTorch) running locally rather than a built-in insights feature. Missing for 10: documentation of what data G-Assist analyzes and what insights or suggestions it gives, insights on general user data rather than just system tuning, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
